sentences.text:
The petitioners whose land was acquired under the provisions of the Railways Act, 1989 and compensation was determined under an award dated 07.05.2018, are now praying for rehabilitation and re-settlement award as per the provisions of Chapter-V of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (herein after referred to as the 'Act, 2013') on the ground that the provisions of the new Act have been extended to the Railways Act, 1989 in terms of Section 105.
3.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the claim of the petitioners is similar to the one raised in Writ-C No.2782 of 2023 (Ashok Kumar and 8 others vs. National Highway Authority of India and 3 others), which was disposed of by this Court, by order dated 24.2.2023 in terms of the order passed in Writ-C No.21601 of 2022 (Ranvir Singh and 35 others vs. National Highway Authority of India and Competent Authority For Land Acquisition and Others).
4.

entities.text: Ashok Kumar and 8 others vs. National Highway Authority of India and 3 others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Ranvir Singh and 35 others vs. National Highway Authority of India and Competent Authority For Land Acquisition and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri Udit Chandra, Advocate holding brief of Sri Subodh Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the Railways states that it has to be examined that which provision of the said Act has been extended to the acquisition made under the Railways Act, 1989.

5. We may notice that by virtue of Section 20-O of the Railways Act, 1989, the provisions of National Rehabilitation and Resettlement Policy, 2007, notified by the Government of India, have been made applicable in respect of acquisition of land by the Central Government under the Railways Act.

6. In view of the above, it is for the Competent Authority, i.e. respondent No.4- Special Land Acquisition Officer, (Joint Organization), Saharanpur to examine the claim of the petitioners strictly in accordance with law in terms of Section 31 of the Act, 2013 read with Section 20-O of the Act,
1989 and take a decision as regards making resettlement and rehabilitation award within a period of twelve weeks from the date a true attested copy of instant order is filed by the petitioners before the Competent Authority alongwith a fresh application.
7.
The petition stands disposed of, accordingly.
